mapper.select: SELECT s.SEM_YEAR AS year, s.SEM_TERM AS termCode, l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, u.LEC_UPL_ID AS uploadId, u.LEC_UPL_TITLE AS title, u.LEC_UPL_CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(u.LEC_UPL_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS uploadedAt FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_UPLOADING u ON u.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' ORDER BY s.SEM_YEAR DESC, CASE s.SEM_TERM WHEN 'WNT' THEN 4 WHEN 'SM2' THEN 3 WHEN 'SMR' THEN 2 WHEN 'SM1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_SECTION, l.LEC_ID, u.LEC_UPL_REG_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, u.LEC_UPL_ID DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT a.LEC_UPL_ID AS uploadId, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS fileExt, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize FROM LECTURE_UPLOADING_ATTACHMENT a WHERE a.LEC_UPL_ID IN #{id} AND a.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY a.LEC_UPL_ID, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_REG_DATE, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ID

SELECT a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME AS trnFileName FROM LECTURE_UPLOADING_ATTACHMENT a JOIN LECTURE_UPLOADING u ON u.LEC_UPL_ID = a.LEC_UPL_ID JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = u.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} WHERE a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ID = #{attachmentId} AND a.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP'
